LanguageData.PhobosDosing_SettingEnabled: Doctors give medication on their own
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_SettingEnabledDesc: A patient who is down or in bed and in severe pain gets the best painkiller within reach; in extreme pain, a sedative when no medical painkiller can be given. A patient who is bleeding hard waits for a painkiller until that is under control. Off, doctors give none of this without your order.
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_SettingMinimumCare: Dose patients whose medical care is at least
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_SettingMinimumCareDesc: Only patients whose medical care setting is this level or better are dosed. "No medicine" and "no medical care" are never dosed.
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_SettingRecreationalDesc: Off by default: only medical drugs are given. On, social and hard drugs that relieve pain may be given as a last resort, when no medical painkiller or sedative can be.
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_SettingIgnoreAversion: Give medical drugs to patients who refuse drugs
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_SettingIgnoreAversionDesc: Off by default: a patient who would not take drugs (a teetotaler, or by belief) is not dosed. On, medical drugs are given anyway; recreational ones never.
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_SettingImmunity: Doctors give drugs that help fight disease
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_SettingImmunityDesc: A patient in bed with a disease that could kill them, and that is winning the race against their immunity, gets a medical drug that speeds their immunity up. Only doctors give these, and a patient who is winning the race gets none, so your stock lasts.
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_SettingSelfMedication: People in pain fetch their own painkillers
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_SettingSelfMedicationDesc: A colonist who is up and about and in serious pain goes and takes the best painkiller their drug policy allows, for joy or on a schedule. Chemical interest and fascination make them reach for it sooner and ignore the policy, as they do for joy. Teetotalers never do. Addiction and overdose are real risks: choose your drug policies with this in mind.
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_SettingGuestsSelfMedicate: Guests may take painkillers from your stock
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_SettingGuestsSelfMedicateDe: Off by default. On, guests in serious pain do the same, from whatever is within their reach. Guests have no drug policy, so they take medical painkillers only, never recreational ones. Useful with mods that bring many guests, such as Hospitality.
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_RefusalSedativeNotWanted: only a sedative ({DRUG}) is in reach, and the pain is not that bad
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_RefusalRecreationalOff: only a recreational drug ({DRUG}) is in reach, and doctors here will not give it for pain
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_RefusalCare: the patient's medical care level does not allow it
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_RefusalMentalState: the patient is in an aggressive mental state
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_RefusalStillActive: an earlier dose is still working
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_RefusalDangerousDose: another dose of {DRUG} would be dangerous
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_RefusalConsciousness: {DRUG} would leave the patient too close to unconsciousness
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_RefusalBleedingHold: {DRUG} must wait until the bleeding is under control
LanguageData.PhobosDosing_RefusalBreathing: {DRUG} would leave the patient unable to breathe
